ESV.1: when I would heal Israel, the iniquity of Ephraim is revealed, and the evil deeds of Samaria, for they deal falsely; the thief breaks in, and the bandits raid outside.
ESV.2: But they do not consider that I remember all their evil. Now their deeds surround them; they are before my face.
ESV.3: By their evil they make the king glad, and the princes by their treachery.
ESV.4: They are all adulterers; they are like a heated oven whose baker ceases to stir the fire, from the kneading of the dough until it is leavened.
ESV.5: On the day of our king, the princes became sick with the heat of wine; he stretched out his hand with mockers.
ESV.6: For with hearts like an oven they approach their intrigue; all night their anger smolders; in the morning it blazes like a flaming fire.
ESV.7: All of them are hot as an oven, and they devour their rulers. All their kings have fallen, and none of them calls upon me.
ESV.8: Ephraim mixes himself with the peoples; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
ESV.9: Strangers devour his strength, and he knows it not; gray hairs are sprinkled upon him, and he knows it not.
ESV.10: The pride of Israel testifies to his face;  yet they do not return to the LORD their God, nor seek him, for all this.
ESV.11: Ephraim is like a dove, silly and without sense, calling to Egypt, going to Assyria.
ESV.12: As they go, I will spread over them my net; I will bring them down like birds of the heavens; I will discipline them according to the report made to their congregation.
ESV.13: Woe to them, for they have strayed from me! Destruction to them, for they have rebelled against me! I would redeem them, but they speak lies against me.
ESV.14: They do not cry to me from the heart, but they wail upon their beds; for grain and wine they gash themselves; they rebel against me.
ESV.15: Although I trained and strengthened their arms, yet they devise evil against me.
ESV.16: They return, but not upward;  they are like a treacherous bow; their princes shall fall by the sword because of the insolence of their tongue. This shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.

NLT.1:
“I want to heal Israel, but its sins are too great.
Samaria is filled with liars.
Thieves are on the inside
and bandits on the outside!
NLT.2:
Its people don’t realize
that I am watching them.
Their sinful deeds are all around them,
and I see them all.
NLT.3:
“The people entertain the king with their wickedness,
and the princes laugh at their lies.
NLT.4:
They are all adulterers,
always aflame with lust.
They are like an oven that is kept hot
while the baker is kneading the dough.
NLT.5:
On royal holidays, the princes get drunk with wine,
carousing with those who mock them.
NLT.6:
Their hearts are like an oven
blazing with intrigue.
Their plot smolders through the night,
and in the morning it breaks out like a raging fire.
NLT.7:
Burning like an oven,
they consume their leaders.
They kill their kings one after another,
and no one cries to me for help.
NLT.8:
“The people of Israel mingle with godless foreigners,
making themselves as worthless as a half-baked cake!
NLT.9:
Worshiping foreign gods has sapped their strength,
but they don’t even know it.
Their hair is gray,
but they don’t realize they’re old and weak.
NLT.10:
Their arrogance testifies against them,
yet they don’t return to the LORD their God
or even try to find him.
NLT.11:
“The people of Israel have become like silly, witless doves,
first calling to Egypt, then flying to Assyria for help.
NLT.12:
But as they fly about,
I will throw my net over them
and bring them down like a bird from the sky.
I will punish them for all the evil they do.
NLT.13:
“What sorrow awaits those who have deserted me!
Let them die, for they have rebelled against me.
I wanted to redeem them,
but they have told lies about me.
NLT.14:
They do not cry out to me with sincere hearts.
Instead, they sit on their couches and wail.
They cut themselves, begging foreign gods for grain and new wine,
and they turn away from me.
NLT.15:
I trained them and made them strong,
yet now they plot evil against me.
NLT.16:
They look everywhere except to the Most High.
They are as useless as a crooked bow.
Their leaders will be killed by their enemies
because of their insolence toward me.
Then the people of Egypt
will laugh at them.

AMP.1:
When I would heal Israel,
The sin (guilt) of Ephraim is uncovered,
And the wickedness of Samaria,
Because they practice false dealing;
The thief enters,
Bandits ravage and raid outside.
AMP.2:
But they do not consider in their hearts (minds)
That I remember [always] all their wickedness.
Now their deeds surround and entangle them;
They are before My face.
AMP.3:
They make the king glad with their wickedness,
And the princes with their lies.
AMP.4:
They are all adulterers;
Like the heat of an oven
When the baker ceases to stir the fire, [their passion smolders]
From the kneading of the dough until it is leavened.
AMP.5:
On the [special] day of our king, the princes became sick with the heat of wine;
The king stretched out his hand [in association] with scoffers (lawless people).
AMP.6:
As they approach their plotting,
Their mind burns [with intrigue] like an oven [while they lie in wait].
Their anger smolders all night;
In the morning it blazes like a flaming fire.
AMP.7:
They are all hot like an oven
And they consume their judges (rulers);
All their kings have fallen.
There is no one among them who calls to Me.
AMP.8:
Ephraim mixes himself with the [Gentile] nations [seeking favor with one country, then another];
Ephraim is a cake not turned [worthless; ready to be thrown away].
AMP.9:
Strangers have devoured his strength,
Yet he does not know it;
Gray hairs are sprinkled on him,
Yet he does not know.
AMP.10:
Though the pride of Israel testifies against him,
Yet they do not return [in repentance] to the LORD their God,
Nor seek nor search for nor desire Him [as essential] in spite of all this.
AMP.11:
Ephraim also is like a silly dove, without heart or good sense;
They call to Egypt [for help], they go to Assyria.
AMP.12:
When they go, I will spread My net over them;
I will bring them down like birds of the heavens [into Assyrian captivity].
I will chastise them in accordance with the proclamation (prophecy) to their congregation.
AMP.13:
Woe (judgment is coming) to them, for they have wandered away from Me!
Devastation is theirs, because they have rebelled and trespassed against Me!
I would redeem them, but they speak lies against Me.
AMP.14:
They do not cry out to Me from their heart
When they wail on their beds [in unbelieving despair];
For the sake of grain and new wine they assemble themselves [as if worshiping Baal];
They rebel against Me.
AMP.15:
Although I trained and strengthened their arms [for victory over their enemies],
Yet they devise evil against Me.
AMP.16:
They turn, but they do not turn upward to the Most High.
They are like a poorly crafted bow [that misses the mark];
Their princes shall fall by the sword
Because of the insolence of their tongue.
This will be cause for their mockery and disdain in the land of Egypt.

MSG.1:
"Every time I gave Israel a fresh start,
wiped the slate clean and got them going again,
Ephraim soon filled the slate with new sins,
the treachery of Samaria written out in bold print.
Two-faced and double-tongued,
they steal you blind, pick you clean.
MSG.2:
It never crosses their mind
that I keep account of their every crime.
They're mud-spattered head to toe with the residue of sin.
I see who they are and what they've done.
MSG.3:
"They entertain the king with their evil circus,
delight the princes with their acrobatic lies.
MSG.4:
They're a bunch of overheated adulterers,
like an oven that holds its heat
From the kneading of the dough
to the rising of the bread.
MSG.5:
On the royal holiday the princes get drunk
on wine and the frenzy of the mocking mob.
MSG.6:
They're like wood stoves,
red-hot with lust.
Through the night their passion is banked;
in the morning it blazes up, flames hungrily licking.
MSG.7:
Murderous and volcanic,
they incinerate their rulers.
Their kings fall one by one,
and no one pays any attention to me.
MSG.8:
"Ephraim mingles with the pagans, dissipating himself.
Ephraim is half-baked.
MSG.9:
Strangers suck him dry
but he doesn't even notice.
His hair has turned gray—
he doesn't notice.
MSG.10:
Bloated by arrogance, big as a house,
Israel's a public disgrace.
Israel lumbers along oblivious to God,
despite all the signs, ignoring God.
MSG.11:
"Ephraim is bird-brained,
mindless, clueless,
First chirping after Egypt,
then fluttering after Assyria.
MSG.12:
I'll throw my net over them. I'll clip their wings.
I'll teach them to mind me!
MSG.13:
Doom! They've run away from home.
Now they're really in trouble! They've defied me.
And I'm supposed to help them
while they feed me a line of lies?
MSG.14:
Instead of crying out to me in heartfelt prayer,
they whoop it up in bed with their whores,
Gash themselves bloody in their sex-and-religion orgies,
but turn their backs on me.
MSG.15:
I'm the one who gave them good minds and healthy bodies,
and how am I repaid? With evil scheming!
MSG.16:
They turn, but not to me—
turn here, then there, like a weather vane.
Their rulers will be cut down, murdered—
just deserts for their mocking blasphemies.
And the final sentence?
Ridicule in the court of world opinion.

they are before my face.
NRSVCE.3:
By their wickedness they make the king glad,
and the officials by their treachery.
NRSVCE.4:
They are all adulterers;
they are like a heated oven,
whose baker does not need to stir the fire,
from the kneading of the dough until it is leavened.
NRSVCE.5:
On the day of our king the officials
became sick with the heat of wine;
he stretched out his hand with mockers.
NRSVCE.6:
For they are kindled like an oven, their heart burns within them;
all night their anger smolders;
in the morning it blazes like a flaming fire.
NRSVCE.7:
All of them are hot as an oven,
and they devour their rulers.
All their kings have fallen;
none of them calls upon me.
NRSVCE.8:
Ephraim mixes himself with the peoples;
Ephraim is a cake not turned.
NRSVCE.9:
Foreigners devour his strength,
but he does not know it;
gray hairs are sprinkled upon him,
but he does not know it.
NRSVCE.10:
Israel’s pride testifies against him;
yet they do not return to the LORD their God,
or seek him, for all this.
NRSVCE.11:
Ephraim has become like a dove,
silly and without sense;
they call upon Egypt, they go to Assyria.
NRSVCE.12:
As they go, I will cast my net over them;
I will bring them down like birds of the air;
I will discipline them according to the report made to their assembly.
NRSVCE.13:
Woe to them, for they have strayed from me!
Destruction to them, for they have rebelled against me!
I would redeem them,
but they speak lies against me.
NRSVCE.14:
They do not cry to me from the heart,
but they wail upon their beds;
they gash themselves for grain and wine;
they rebel against me.
NRSVCE.15:
It was I who trained and strengthened their arms,
yet they plot evil against me.
NRSVCE.16:
They turn to that which does not profit;
they have become like a defective bow;
their officials shall fall by the sword
because of the rage of their tongue.
So much for their babbling in the land of Egypt.

NET.1: whenever I want to heal Israel, the sin of Ephraim is revealed, and the evil deeds of Samaria are exposed. For they do what is wrong; thieves break into houses, and gangs rob people out in the streets.
NET.2: They do not realize that I remember all of their wicked deeds. Their evil deeds have now surrounded them; their sinful deeds are always before me.
NET.3: The royal advisers delight the king with their evil schemes, the princes make him glad with their lies.
NET.4: They are all like bakers, they are like a smoldering oven; they are like a baker who does not stoke the fire until the kneaded dough is ready for baking.
NET.5: At the celebration of their king, his princes become inflamed with wine; they conspire with evildoers.
NET.6: They approach him, all the while plotting against him. Their hearts are like an oven; their anger smolders all night long, but in the morning it bursts into a flaming fire.
NET.7: All of them are blazing like an oven; they devour their rulers. All of their kings fall — and none of them call on me!
NET.8: Ephraim has mixed itself like flour among the nations; Ephraim is like a ruined cake of bread that is scorched on one side.
NET.9: Foreigners are consuming what his strenuous labor produced, but he does not recognize it! His head is filled with gray hair, but he does not realize it!
NET.10: The arrogance of Israel testifies against him, yet they refuse to return to the LORD their God! In spite of all this they refuse to seek him!
NET.11: Ephraim has been like a dove, easily deceived and lacking discernment. They called to Egypt for help; they turned to Assyria for protection.
NET.12: I will throw my bird net over them while they are flying, I will bring them down like birds in the sky; I will discipline them when I hear them flocking together.
NET.13: Woe to them! For they have fled from me! Destruction to them! For they have rebelled against me! I want to deliver them, but they have lied to me.
NET.14: They do not pray to me, but howl in distress on their beds; They slash themselves for grain and new wine, but turn away from me.
NET.15: Although I trained and strengthened them, they plot evil against me!
NET.16: They turn to Baal; they are like an unreliable bow. Their leaders will fall by the sword because their prayers to Baal have made me angry. So people will disdain them in the land of Egypt.
